articles.title: Gwen Kim, 79, Longtime Volunteer
articles.deck: Friends remember Gwen Kim for the many years of service to Lower Millrace.
body: Survivors include a daughter, two grandchildren and many friends from Lower Millrace. Gwen Kim died in April at home on Heron Avenue, at the age of 79.
Born in Lower Millrace in the years after the war, Gwen Kim spent most of a working life in the trades and most of a retirement in the neighborhood.
Services will be held at the parish hall, and donations may be made to the Canal Park Food Pantry in his or her name.
